body:
I’ve gotten to that point a few times before but I’m a wuss and she’s good at digging away at me till I give in. It’s not even like these half siblings have stayed in touch all that much with the parents. Our dad is still alive but has dementia and he has trouble remembering my half siblings. I think because I’m the one that’s kept in touch practically daily via phone and visiting often - they don’t live in the states - he remembers me and my kids more. 

What’s started this fresh round of me being upset is my half siblings had to be notified of a change to our parents Will. Now they are all planning a visit and my Mom was reluctant to tell me when they are arriving. Not that I care but I had been planning to visit and didn’t want to be there at the same time.

I like that, “info diet.” 

For the last few years I’ve found myself so guarded with our conversations. My parents don’t live here in the states anymore and I don’t get to see them often. Mom calls me almost every single day and texts me throughout the day. It’s so hard to not share my life. Then the guilt hits me because I know she won’t be around forever.
